technique_name: Identify the different types of conflict.
description: The different types of conflicts include interpersonal conflicts, intrapersonal conflicts, performace conflicts, resource conflicts, role conflicts, values conflicts, and task conflicts. Interpersonal conflicts arise when individuals have conflicting goals, wants, or needs. Intrapersonal conflicts occur when individuals are in conflict with themselves.
